//: Copy this file to config/tenant-pulse.json and fill it in. That path is gitignored.
Secrets can also come from the environment instead of this file:
TENANTPULSE_SHARED_PASSWORD   shared demo-user password (UsernamePassword auth mode only)

Tenant.//: AllowedTenantIds is the safety guardrail. tenant-pulse refuses to run unless TenantId is listed here.
Tenant.//ClientId: Application (client) id of a PUBLIC CLIENT Entra app registration in the demo tenant.

Auth.//Mode: DeviceCode (supported, one interactive sign-in per user) or UsernamePassword (unattended, deprecated by Microsoft but usually fine in a demo tenant).
Auth.//SharedPassword: Only used when Mode=UsernamePassword. Prefer the TENANTPULSE_SHARED_PASSWORD environment variable.

Simulation.//DryRun: true means nothing is written to the tenant. Pass --live on the command line to act.

Limits.//: Deliberately conservative. This is not a load test — it is a tenant that looks used.

Content.//CompanyName: The fictional company the personas work for. Steers every generated email, chat and document.

Copilot.//UseGraphChatApi: Graph beta Copilot Chat API. Run 'tenant-pulse verify-copilot --live' to confirm prompts register as usage in your tenant.
Copilot.//Agents: Copilot Studio agents reachable over Direct Line. Get the secret from the agent's Web channel security settings.

Agents.Name: HR Assistant
SamplePrompts: How many days of annual leave do I have left?
What's the process for booking business travel?

Workloads.//Agents: Off by default — needs a Copilot Studio agent and Direct Line secret above.
Workloads.//SharePointSites: Optional. Server-relative paths, e.g. /sites/Marketing. Empty means use each persona's OneDrive.
Workloads.//TeamNames: Optional allow-list of teams to post into. Empty means any team the actor belongs to.
